Of all the tickets printed for "PREMIER PLAY", most are still unsold. The game is near the start of its run, with three of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Tomorrow's count on "PREMIER PLAY" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2414.headline: Where this game is in its run

2415.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Double The Money", about half are still unsold. The game is near the midpoint of its run, with two of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Every line of Double The Money's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2415.headline: Tickets sold so far

2416.body:
The most common win left on "Loaded with $2,000s" is $20. The second biggest prize left is $500, and 1,219 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If you play "Loaded with $2,000s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2416.headline: What the prize table shows

2419.body:

The numbers for "Bronze 7s" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.

2420.headline: Someone claimed a $177,777 prize

2421.headline: Another top prize was claimed

2422.body:
The top prize count on "Platinum 7s" has not moved for close to two months. The game still has two of three top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

The second-biggest prize left on "Platinum 7s" is $70,000, with two of them remaining.

Everything above about "Platinum 7s" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.

2427.headline: Early stage or late

2428.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "PEPPERMINT PAYOUT", nearly all are still unsold. The game is still new, with five of five top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Everything here about "PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through October 28.
2428.headline: Early stage or late

2429.body:
"MERRY MONEY TREE" is early in its run, with nearly all of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

The table below shows the full count for "MERRY MONEY TREE", with every prize level included.
2429.headline: How far along this game is

2430.body:
The prize money on "WRAPPED IN RICHES" leans toward small, frequent prizes. It is spread over ten prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $500,000. Games built like this pay small prizes often and large prizes rarely. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

If you play "WRAPPED IN RICHES" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
